decisions.reason: As a rye bread built directly on our established baking knowledge in a growing market, it fits our core capabilities and gives little reason for withdrawal.
This premium raisin Christmas stollen is very close to our confectionery strengths and the reported gold medal is a strong signal to retain it.
A rye mixed bread with seeds is a familiar extension of our existing bread expertise, so we can readily assess and improve it despite limited formal R&D.
Dark barley malt rye bread remains closely related to our core bread know-how, though its somewhat more specific taste profile makes it slightly more at risk than standard variants.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is a near-core seasonal product for a bakery-confectionery like ours, so it is likely to stay even without special performance evidence.
Ancient grain bread is still based on our breadmaking capabilities but is the most novel and ingredient-specific variant here, so it carries the highest but still moderate risk of being dropped.
